# hotin

> A free, open-source CLI that ranks what's hot in AI right now — trending GitHub repos, the repos AI insiders are backing, new models and papers, and AI news — by cross-source consensus and freshness. Live board updated daily at https://hotin.ai.

## What it is
hotin is a zero-dependency Python command-line tool. It fuses independent signals (GitHub trending/search, Hacker News, npm, Reddit, an AI-insider star graph, Hugging Face models and papers, and AI news) and ranks projects by how many sources agree plus how fresh they are.

## Install
- pip install hotin
- uvx hotin
- pipx install hotin
- Zero-install single file: python hotin.pyz (from GitHub Releases)

## Key facts
- Free and open-source, Apache-2.0.
- Author: Abe Diaz (https://github.com/abe238).
- Source: https://github.com/abe238/hotinai
- Package: https://pypi.org/project/hotin/

## Commands
- hotin repos — trending AI repos, fused across sources
- hotin rising — brand-new repos climbing fastest (star velocity)
- hotin insiders — repos AI insiders are backing (smart-money)
- hotin models — frontier-lab releases + trending model weights
- hotin papers — trending AI papers
- hotin news — recent AI news
- Add --since 7d to see only the last 7 days.
